description: Designs a hands-on technical workshop program delivered to one customer or prospect account at a time: the grant rule agreed with sales, a lab catalog mapped to discovery, the lab environment standard, instructor certification, the next-step agreement and account-level metrics. Use whenever someone runs or plans customer workshops, immersion days or hands-on labs for a customer's engineers, hears an AE ask "can we do a workshop for them next week", sees workshops end with no POC, or needs SEs or partners trained to deliver them - even if they only say "our workshops don't convert". Do NOT use for a session inside a conference - use samber/dev-event-organizer-skills@workshop-program-design - or a paid training catalog - use samber/developer-relations-skills@developer-education-strategy.
